message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, the first commercial vertiport VDX has been opened.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The first purpose-built commercial vertiport VDX for electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft has been completed in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The vertiport is located near Dubai International Airport.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The vertiport is designed to handle up to 170,000 passengers per year.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Schneider Electric provided the energy and digital infrastructure for the vertiport, including high-voltage systems, building management, and power quality monitoring.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"This infrastructure will optimize energy consumption and maintain flight safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project supports Dubai's 2040 Urban Master Plan.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"The project will reduce travel time across the city from 45 to 12 minutes.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}
